meta.title: YouMind · AI Creation Studio | Capture Ideas, Ship Work
meta.description: YouMind is an AI creation studio for creators and learners: capture inspiration from web, YouTube, podcasts and Office docs, let AI find the logic, and ship work — so learning and creation stop being separate.

landing.badge: The pen and paper of the AI era
landing.heroTitle: Break the boundary between learning and creation — turn scattered materials into work you're proud of
landing.heroSubtitle: YouMind is an AI workspace that fuses knowledge management with content creation. Capture from PDFs, web pages, videos, podcasts and Office docs in one place; AI helps you find the logic and deep insight, closing the loop from idea to finished work.

capabilities.title: Capture everything, everywhere
capabilities.desc: With a browser extension and mobile app, save web pages, YouTube videos, podcast audio and Office docs anytime — building your private inspiration library.

capabilities.title: Personalized AI logic
capabilities.desc: Unlike templated Q&A, YouMind learns your reading habits and point of view, producing content that truly matches your own insight style.

capabilities.title: Immersive creation flow
capabilities.desc: AI-generated reports turn into fully editable documents in one click — review, rewrite and refine in the same space, no more tool-hopping.

capabilities.title: Structured Board management
capabilities.desc: Organize massive materials on an intuitive kanban, quickly finding the logical architecture among thousands of sources.

steps.title: Collect
steps.desc: Drop what you see and think into YouMind; save web pages, videos and podcasts in one tap.

steps.title: Organize
steps.desc: AI summarizes the key points and connects the dots into reusable knowledge.

steps.title: Ship
steps.desc: Generate a draft in one line, then iterate in the same space into work you love.

usecases.title: Creators: from fragments to narrative
usecases.desc: Auto-link scattered notes and references, surface hidden themes, and quickly build original stories with depth and support.

usecases.title: Researchers: efficient synthesis
usecases.desc: Facing dense literature, YouMind rapidly synthesizes complex material into clear reports and briefs, tuned to each audience's tone.

usecases.title: Lifelong learners: deep absorption
usecases.desc: Turn long videos or dense text into approachable examples, notes and visual sketches — making learning interactive thinking.

tools.title: Writing
tools.desc: Outlines, first drafts, rewrites and polish — from a single sentence to a long essay.

tools.title: Social media
tools.desc: Turn materials into viral copy for Xiaohongshu, Weibo, X and more.

tools.title: Learning
tools.desc: Summarize courses, break down concepts, generate study cards and mind maps.

tools.title: Images
tools.desc: Ideate illustrations, covers and infographic drafts for articles and social.

tools.title: Video
tools.desc: Extract video highlights, generate scripts and short-video copy.

tools.title: Presentation
tools.desc: Turn materials into a clear, well-structured slide outline in one click.

tools.title: Job hunting
tools.desc: Polish your résumé, rehearse interviews, write a cover letter that lands.

faq.a: Web pages, YouTube videos, podcasts, PDFs and Office docs — captured in one click via the browser extension or mobile app.
Yes. Every AI-generated report turns into a fully editable document you can review, rewrite and refine in the same space.
Your inspiration library is private by default and visible only to you; you can export or delete your materials and works anytime.
YouMind supports 13 languages including Chinese and English; this site also ships independent pages per language for easy access.

landing.ctaFinalTitle: Start now — turn inspiration into work
landing.ctaFinalText: Whether it's an article, a talk, or a set of study notes, YouMind walks every step with you, from spark to finished piece.

footer.tagline: YouMind · where learning and creation stop being separate
